title: ABS Ops Intent Schema v1
description: Schema for operational intents sent from Clawdbot to ABS Kernel

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific intent request

actor_id.description: Identifier of the human operator (e.g., telegram:12345678)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (ms) of intent creation. Used for replay protection.

scope_key.description: Security scope for permissions and rate limiting

reason.description: Human-provided reason for the action (required for R2/R3)

nonce.description: Random string to prevent replay attacks

ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live for this intent in milliseconds (max 60000)

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the payload using Clawdbot's secret (to prove origin to ABS)
